notes.title: No Time To Build – Now Available on Steam! 🏗️🔥
notes.content:
The moment has arrived!

No Time to Build is officially out and available to play right now!

But this is just the beginning!

We will continue improving the game, adding new content, and introducing more challenges. Every purchase helps us make No Time to Build even better!

Join the fun, overcome obstacles, and enjoy the chaotic co-op experience! 🚀

notes.title: No time to build - Release is already April 1st!
notes.content:
No Time to Build launches on April 1st! Add it to your wishlist and get ready for co-op chaos!

We’re excited to announce that No Time to Build will be launching on April 1st on Steam! This is a co-op online game for two players, where teamwork is key. One player takes on the role of a beaver, while the other plays as a capybara. Together, you’ll gather resources, build bridges, and complete the construction before time runs out!

🏗 Co-op Madness!
In No Time to Build, teamwork is everything. Coordinate your actions to collect resources faster and avoid traps. But be careful – accidental collisions can lead to chaos!

🎯 Physics, Parkour & Traps!
You’ll face moving platforms, disappearing paths, trains, bombs, and more. Use your parkour skills to navigate obstacles, and keep an eye on your surroundings – they can change at any moment!

⏳ Build Faster – Time is Running Out!
Your main goal is to deliver enough logs to the construction zone before time runs out. The maps are full of tricky elements, so quick and precise teamwork is a must!

🔥 Unique Mechanics & Features:
✔ Chop trees and collect logs with the E key.
✔ Carry resources and build bridges together.
✔ Use portals and speed bushes to move faster.
✔ Push, jump, and interact with your teammate (but don’t get in each other’s way!).

🎩 Character Customization
Make your beaver or capybara stand out! The final version of the game will include:
🎩 8 unique hats
✨ 3 walking particle effects
⭕ 3 character circles
🔧 Upgrades for speed and jumping

🗺 Diverse Locations
🌾 Farm
🏙 City
❄ Winter
🤠 Wild West

🚀 What to Expect in the Full Release?
✅ 20 multiplayer maps – test your teamwork skills!
✅ 18 single-player maps – a challenge for solo players!
✅ Full customization – hats, effects, and more!

📅 No Time to Build launches on April 1st! Add it to your Steam wishlist to support the project and be the first to play!
